sources.title: Your Writing Style Is a Fingerprint — And AI Can Read It in 30 Messages
sources.snippet: Here's a question most HR leaders have never considered: if you paste an "anonymous" survey response into an AI model alongside a team's Slack history, can the AI identify who wrote it? The answer, according to peer-reviewed research, is yes — with over 90% accuracy. The field is called stylometry — the science of identifying authors by how they write, not what they write.
